# archestra_skill (Resource)

A versioned skill with declarative manifest metadata, instruction body and complete resource files. Import by UUID. Updates reject stale versions. Destroy soft-deletes the skill; immutable historical versions remain under platform retention. Sharing uses a separate archestra_resource_permission_policy. Git-synchronized content remains owned by its external source and the API rejects conflicting edits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_skill" "procedure" {
  name        = "repository-procedure"
  description = "Instructions for repository maintenance"
  content     = "Inspect the repository instructions before making changes."
  files = {
    "references/checklist.md" = {
      content  = "Run the relevant checks and report their results."
      encoding = "utf8"
    }
  }
  environment_ids = []
  labels          = []
}

# Files, environment restrictions and labels are authoritative collections.
# Updates use the last observed immutable version; a conflict requires a new plan.
# Destroy soft-deletes the skill instead of permanently purging its history.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Markdown instruction body without frontmatter.
- `description` (String) Skill description rendered into manifest frontmatter.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Complete environment restrictions; an empty set allows every environment.
- `files` (Attributes Map) Complete resource files keyed by relative path; an empty map clears files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Complete set of resource labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `name` (String) Skill name rendered into manifest frontmatter.

### Optional

- `agent_name` (String) Agent name used when activating this skill delegates execution.
- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Tools pre-approved by the skill manifest.
- `compatibility` (String) Manifest compatibility information.
- `icon` (String) Display emoji or image data URL.
- `license` (String) Manifest license.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Manifest metadata entries.
- `templated` (Boolean) Whether the instruction body uses Handlebars rendering.

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Author id reported by the API.
- `created_at` (String) Created at reported by the API.
- `created_by` (String) Creator identity metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Created by service account id reported by the API.
- `deleted_at` (String) Deleted at reported by the API.
- `digest` (String) Digest reported by the API.
- `file_digests` (Map of String) Backend content digests keyed by resource file path.
- `github_app_config_id` (String) Github app config id reported by the API.
- `github_pat_id` (String) Github pat id reported by the API.
- `github_sync_interval` (String) Github sync interval reported by the API.
- `github_sync_ref` (String) Github sync ref reported by the API.
- `gitlab_token_id` (String) Gitlab token id reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Skill UUID.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Last sync error reported by the API.
- `last_synced_at` (String) Last synced at reported by the API.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last used at reported by the API.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest immutable content version used for optimistic updates.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id reported by the API.
- `scope` (String) Scope reported by the API.
- `source_commit` (String) Source commit reported by the API.
- `source_origin` (String) Source origin reported by the API.
- `source_provider` (String) Source provider reported by the API.
- `source_ref` (String) Source ref reported by the API.
- `source_type` (String) Source type reported by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at reported by the API.
- `usage_count` (Number) Recorded activation count.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by skill UUID.
terraform import archestra_skill.procedure 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
